decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-d83aa8e2cc23], is a one-line changelog title saying that logs RBAC is now enforced by default. It does not name the setting that controlled enforcement before, its old or new default, or which RBAC policies or principals would lose log access. Because of that, I can't confirm the proposed exposure: blaming the uncertainty on runtime behaviour may be wrong when the real gap could be missing evidence about a static config key and the RBAC policy contents. To decide, I need the upgrade guide or PR #21678 text naming the setting and its defaults, plus which policy configuration keeps log access.
